# MA Electric Delivery Tariffs
Still to-do:
- Berkshire has variable LDAF and revenue adjustment factors (https://www.berkshiregas.com/account/understandyourbill/other_rates_information)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(jsonlite)
library(RSQLite)
library(readxl)

source("/workspaces/reports/lib/ggplot/switchbox_theme.R")

library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)

url_sheet_delivery_tariffs_gas_ma <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ikBwsX3UF4RheRrEoQzAHFqwXbI07Z-iXEiIEYraFNI/edit?gid=0#gid=0"
googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
tariffs_gas_raw <- read_sheet(url_sheet_delivery_tariffs_gas_ma, sheet = "delivery_tariffs_gas_ma") |>
  mutate(tariff_id = paste0(gas_utility, "_", tariff_name)) |>

  # 1 therm = 29.3 kWh...ResStock data is in kWh
  mutate(
    value = if_else(billing_unit == "therm", value / 29.3, value)
  ) |>
  select(-source)

summer_months <- c(5,6,7,8,9,10)
winter_months <- c(11,12,1,2,3,4)

# The tariffs are specified by season, so we need to expand them out to the monthly grid
delivery_tariffs_gas <- tariffs_gas_raw |>
  mutate(
    month = if_else(season == "summer",
                    list(summer_months),
                    list(winter_months))
  ) |>
  select(-season) |>
  unnest(month) |>
  arrange(gas_utility, month)

# Collapse distribution_rate, adjustment_rate, and ldac into a single delivery_rate
delivery_tariffs_gas <- delivery_tariffs_gas |>
  group_by(class, gas_utility, customer_class, version, tariff_name, month, tariff_id) |>
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      type %in% c("distribution_rate", "adjustment_rate", "ldac") ~ "delivery_rate",
      TRUE ~ type
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(class, gas_utility, customer_class, version, tariff_name, month, tariff_id, type) |>
  summarise(
    value = sum(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(gas_utility, month)


#path_rs_db <- "data/ResStock/2022_resstock_amy2018_release_1.1/rs_ma_hp_rates.db"
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), path_rs_db)
DBI::dbWriteTable(
  con,
  "delivery_tariffs_gas",
  delivery_tariffs_gas,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```
